description: This file defines a struct 'Tag' used in serialization within the Orleans.Serialization.WireProtocol namespace. It encapsulates the concept of a byte-sized tag used as part of serialized data headers, with constants and properties for manipulating bits related to wire type, schema type, and field identifiers. The struct includes methods for implicit conversions, property accessors for tag components, and internal logic for validity checks and special cases.
